ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
python_min:
- '3.11'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zstd:
- '1.5'
name: backports.zstd
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.8.0"

recipe:
  name: backports.zstd-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/b/backports.zstd/backports_zstd-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9dae4f4c481716e3db473d667457b4f508ff7459c0931b567a5c9677fb3db316

build:
  number: 1
  # no builds needed on platforms which only ship python 3.14+
  skip: match(python_min, ">=3.14")

# To allow downstream `noarch: python` feedstocks to unconditionally depend
# on `backports.zstd` without having their _own_ variants, this builds multiple
# `outputs` with the same name, but different build strings, per upstream release:
#
# - one build that links against `zstd` and `python` per {platform x architecture x python}
#   for python 3.10-3.13
# - a single, empty, `noarch: generic` build (built on `linux-64`) which can be
#   installed on python 3.14+

outputs:
  - package:
      name: backports.zstd
    build:
      skip: match(python, ">=3.14")
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --config-settings=--build-option=--system-zstd --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
        - zstd
      run:
        - python
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          site_packages:
            - backports/zstd/**
            - backports_zstd-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
      - python:
          imports: backports.zstd
          pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: backports.zstd
    build:
      skip: not (target_platform == "linux-64" and match(python, "3.14.*") and ("cp314t" not in python))
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - python >=3.14
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
      - python:
          imports: compression.zstd
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - 3.14.*
            - 3.15.*
    about:
      summary: Backport of compression.zstd (no-op on Python 3.14+)

about:
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/backports.zstd
  repository: https://github.com/rogdham/backports.zstd
  license: Python-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Backport of compression.zstd

extra:
  feedstock-name: backports.zstd
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rogdham
    - bollwyvl
